evidence_items.finding: net losses in all three years of operation — $120K loss, $98K loss, $74K loss — despite revenue growing from $740K to $1.3M
evidence_items.rationale: Three consecutive net losses while revenue grows is a critical adverse unit economics signal. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: operating expenses have grown from $860K to $1.374M over the three-year period, tracking closely with revenue
evidence_items.rationale: Operating expenses growing proportionally with revenue is a critical adverse cost structure signal. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: the business has added two staff and expanded leased premises as revenue grew, keeping fixed costs high
evidence_items.rationale: Headcount and premises expansion adding to fixed costs as revenue grows is an adverse cost structure signal. financial_health.

evidence_items.finding: owner believes the business has turned the corner now that revenue has recovered to its pre-disruption level
evidence_items.rationale: Owner confidence based on revenue recovery while losses continue is a critical adverse evidence signal. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: consulting firm; 3 consecutive loss years; revenue grew $740K to $1.3M; losses were $120K, $98K, $74K; costs grew proportionally
Surface signal (not root cause): revenue has grown from $740K to $1.3M — a 76% increase over three years
evidence_items.rationale: Revenue growth of 76% is a misleading signal when losses have occurred at every revenue level — the cost structure grows proportionally with revenue.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): the business won two new enterprise clients in the most recent six months, both on multi-year contracts
evidence_items.rationale: New enterprise contract wins are a misleading positive signal when the cost structure prevents profitability regardless of revenue level.

validation_notes: SIM-09-002 is SUPPORTED via unit_economics_failure. Revenue recovery without profitability maps to unit economics failure. No must_identify vocabulary.
